messages.author: 1fb54f491646a589
messages.subject: RE: Standard Error for bootstrapped density estimates
parts:
John, just to clarify – what are you needing?  The standard deviation of the bootstrap density estimates is the standard error of your density estimates from the real data.  Those bootstrap density estimates are available.  But are you wanting the standard errors of the bootstrap density estimates?  That doesn’t seem useful, unless you want to estimate the precision of your standard error estimates.  But there is another issue here:  if you’re using a bootstrap, then there is a reason why you don’t want to use analytic estimates of the standard errors.  So why would you want the analytic standard errors of the bootstrap density estimates?

 

Steve Buckland
